notes.title: My new game is OUT! Automation, Colony Building, Defense
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2349040/Dinky_Guardians/
[previewyoutube=dVbU7jO67A8;full][/previewyoutube]
⬆️ Clone your first [b]🐷Dinky[/b], give them 👉orders to help you, Research 🦾[b]Automation Machines,[/b] Defend your Colony from the 👿Zumbys, Build a 🚀[b]Rocket,[/b] colonize other 🌍Planets and set up supply chains between them! Play [u]Solo👤[/u] or [u]Co-op👥 [/u]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43477750/d49245dbc460be2c1e93bb3df2daf20700599fb8.gif[/img]

[h2]The Ultimate Goal[/h2]
Repopulate the [b]entire galaxy[/b] with Dinkys and fully [b]automate everything[/b] with Machines so that the Dinkys can live their lives in peace!


Play [u]solo[/u] or with up to [u]4 friends[/u] in this fun Colony-Building, Automation, Defense adventure

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2349040/Dinky_Guardians/


Interested in the behind the scenes? Watch my devlogs to see how the game came to be!
https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLzDRvYVwl53ueGEHkpRtO9e-7QZDHNcfa


[b]Thanks and I hope you like the game![/b]
- Hugo (Code Monkey, Endless Loop Studios)
